title: A modified integrated information theory could fix the laws

statements.text: As an illustration, a modified integrated information theory, taking the universe as conscious and placing local subjects where integrated information is maximal, could supply the localization and thinning laws. It would be empirically indiscernible from the original theory.

sources.quote: we can consider a slightly modified form of IIT according to which the existence and consciousness of local subjects is correlated with maximal
will be empirically indiscernible from original IIT
